summary: Gold Amulet with fractured Spirit and +3 Spell Skills (+4 at 40% caster quality), finished with catalysed Perfect Exalts for all-res and cast speed.
benchmarkReason: Single run, counts are what he had on hand: both catalysed Perfect Exalt slams hit a kept suffix (all-res, then cast speed, 3:55-4:52) and the desecration stopped at a low spell damage roll after at least two Omen of Light rerolls (9:36, 10:30), by choice ('we don't want to spend more currency', 10:58-11:02). Anchor: 'you can start this craft with between 50 to 100 divs' (9:59-10:05), his bankroll guidance, which presumably covers the ~35 div Gold base (1:27-1:33) that the planner side also counts on a bought start.

steps: Buy a pre-crafted Gold Amulet with fractured Spirit and a chaos-spammed mod for ~35 div (non-gold ~20-25); the +3 Spell Skills on the base is inferred from '+4 at 40 quality', it is never shown
Omen of Sinistral Exaltation + Exalt a junk prefix (T4 life), then Sinistral Crystallisation + Essence of the Breach removes it and adds the max-quality mod
Caster catalysts to 40% (+4 spell), Catalysing + Dextral Exaltation + Perfect Exalt: all-res; re-quality, repeat: cast speed
Re-quality to 40%, Omen of Sinistral Annulment + Annul removes the max-quality mod (quality stays)
Exalt a prefix (T3 mana), then Preserved Collarbone desecration for rarity/mana/spell damage with Omen of Light + Annul rerolls; kept a low spell damage roll
Catalyst count assumes ~1% quality per catalyst (three fills to 40%); collarbone and light counts are what he had on hand
Stated: 'start this craft with between 50 to 100 divs'; earlier ones sold for 70-75 div, he lists this one at 300

factCheck.notes: Route, base price (35 div gold, 20-25 other), two catalysed Perfect slams, Sinistral Annulment and 'between 50 to 100 divs' match bmDpeUchnBU. Some 'nothing here' reveals may be one bone + Echoes reroll; the bone and Light bands cover it. Upload 2026-06-05 (0.5 Runes of Aldur). Catalyst counts assume ~1% quality per catalyst (creator footage: Diztoh GDLDxn6yxEs 4:24-4:47, OperatorOtter NUiXXbrPS4E 8:36); the KB community formula says ~2% at ilvl 72-84, which would halve them (unresolved).
